summary: AFL's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' bucket fires on all four rows and its MANGA claim is empty on every one of them: Narutopedia's semantic index of Boruto episodes carrying a `Manga Chapter` property returns 71 rows (1, 19-24, 39, 53-66, 106, 148-151, 157, 181-220, 287-293) and 18, 93, 94, 95 are in NONE of them, while their immediate neighbours 19-24 are (the absence-framed-by-neighbours test the ask asked for). Not one page of the Boruto manga (ch 1-80) is in any of the four. What they DO adapt splits 1 + 3. Ep 18: ja-WP's episode-row footnote says the FIRST HALF is based on Kishimoto's manga omake 『ナルトが火影になった日』 printed in the movie book 秘伝・在の書 (2015-08-07), and TV Tokyo's own synopsis carries exactly that story as Boruto's recollection (Himawari's Byakugan awakening on Naruto's inauguration day); the present-day half (Himawari ill, Boruto's resentment, Ichiraku with Naruto, the Akimichi eating-contest cameo) is anime-original — two story-carrying segments, one from a licensed work and one not = MIXED, confirmed as stored, and the omake is delivered as a side_source annotation the row did not have. Eps 93-95: the whole 親子の日編 arc is a straight, in-order adaptation of the licensed novel 『NARUTO -ナルト- ナルト新伝 親子の日』 — ep 93 = prologue + ch 1, ep 94 = ch 3, ep 95 = ch 4, with novel ch 2 (Hinata/Hiashi/Hanabi) and all four interludes cut; no anime-original plot of substance, so the stored CANON + side_source stands and AFL's 'mixed' is the label that lied (its 'filler' component is the novel's own cuts and Boruto's added framing, not original story). No anchors on any of the four (A44: an unnumbered omake and a prose novel carry no number in the Boruto 1-80 space); the position line is untouched — the Boruto anchors around these rows (ep 24's chain material, ep 53 -> ch 1, ep 66 -> ch 10) are unaffected.

anchor_hostile.why: A44 position-less, NOT A1 — the row is MIXED (stored type confirmed) and its source segment is significant, but the work it adapts has NO CHAPTER NUMBER AT ALL. 'The Day Naruto Became Hokage' (BORUTO -NARUTO THE MOVIE- 特別番外編 ナルトが火影になった日) is an unnumbered manga omake by Kishimoto printed inside the movie book 『NARUTO -ナルト- 秘伝・在の書 オフィシャルムービーBOOK』 (2015-08-07, distributed to moviegoers); it sits outside the Boruto manga's serialisation entirely (Boruto ch 1 began in V Jump in May 2016, and the Boruto space's first anchored row is ep 53 -> ch 1). Narutopedia's own per-episode `Manga Chapter` property is ABSENT on this row while the neighbouring 19-24 carry 700-710 — the absence is the positive reading here, because the same wiki has a full page for the omake as a CHAPTER with no number. AFG says the same thing in the one place it prints numbers: its Chapters cell for ep 18 reads the literal string 'OMAKE: The Day Naruto Became Hokage' where ep 19 reads '701, 702'. Nothing is stranded by declining: no numbered Boruto chapter is left unadapted, and the unnumbered omake is recorded as a FACT in the side_source annotation (title, where it is printed, that it precedes the manga's serialisation) exactly as the catalog handles 番外編 / 読切 material.

A44 position-less — the row is CANON (stored type confirmed) but its source is a PROSE NOVEL, another instrument entirely: 『NARUTO -ナルト- ナルト新伝 親子の日』 (Mirei Miyamoto, illustrations Kishimoto; Shueisha 2018-05-02), whose units are a prologue, four chapters and four interludes, not manga chapters. side_source rows carry no chapter mapping by design (A1 / T26 — the Shippuden 452-457 and Sasuke Retsuden precedents, and the ep 282-286 rows on this same series). Narutopedia's `Manga Chapter` index has no entry for this row; AFG's Chapters cell reads the literal string 'NOVEL' (the same tell as Shippuden's licensed-novel block); ja-WP's arc header footnote reads ノベライズ『NARUTO―ナルト― ナルト新伝 親子の日』を原作としてアニメ化. Ep 93 covers the novel's prologue (Naruto approving the holiday, Shikamaru clearing his schedule) and chapter 1 「父と娘、木ノ葉を駆ける」 (Naruto and Himawari hunting the limited-edition Kurama plush).

A44 position-less — same basis as ep 93: the row adapts novel chapter 3 「父と娘、ひとりの食卓」 (the four restaurants planning the eating contest, Karui walking out on Chōji, the Dōtonbori father-and-son challengers, the Ankorodō owner's Earth Release swelling the dumplings, Karui's Lightning Release, Chōji's Butterfly Mode) — prose units, no manga chapter. Narutopedia's `Manga Chapter` index has no entry; AFG prints 'NOVEL'. The two Dōtonbori are novel characters, not anime inventions: ja-WP lists クーイ and his son ダオーレ under 『ナルト新伝 親子の日』に登場.

A44 position-less — same basis as eps 93/94: the row adapts novel chapter 4 「父と娘、冷めた炎と滾る火」 (Sasuke passing through Konoha on Parent and Child Day, his failed attempts to bond with Sarada, Kakashi's Icha Icha advice, the shuriken training and the Hokage conversation) — prose units, no manga chapter. Narutopedia's `Manga Chapter` index has no entry; AFG prints 'NOVEL'; TV Tokyo's synopsis is the same story. The one structural change (Boruto, not Sarada, tells Sasuke about the holiday) is a divergence inside the adaptation, not a second source.

annotations.chapters: The Day Naruto Became Hokage: the unnumbered special extra chapter 『BORUTO -NARUTO THE MOVIE- 特別番外編 ナルトが火影になった日』, printed in 『NARUTO -ナルト- 秘伝・在の書 オフィシャルムービーBOOK』 (Kishimoto, 2015-08-07) — no mainline number, outside the Boruto manga's ch 1-80
annotations.note: THE WORK: Masashi Kishimoto's manga omake 'The Day Naruto Became Hokage', a special extra chapter created for Boruto: Naruto the Movie and printed inside the movie book Hiden: Zai no Sho (which also reprints Naruto ch 700). It carries no chapter number and predates the Boruto manga's serialisation, so it is a licensed work OUTSIDE the series' source, not a Boruto chapter. weight: SIGNIFICANT — because it is the episode's whole first half and it carries the episode's point (why Boruto resents his father): ja-WP's row footnote reads 前半部分は…漫画『ナルトが火影になった日』を原案としている, TV Tokyo's synopsis gives the flashback half its text (ボルトは思い出す――。それは、父・ナルトの火影就任式の日。その日ヒマワリは白眼を覚醒させ、ボルトとナルトは死ぬ思いをした), and Narutopedia's episode page marks the same stretch as its <section begin=summary/> block, beat for beat the omake page's own summary (waking Naruto, the unfinished Hokage cloak, the torn stuffed toy, Himawari's Byakugan, the closed tenketsu, Konohamaru transformed at the inauguration, Boruto hiding in the closet). It is adapted in NO other episode of the run (Narutopedia's per-episode Manga Chapter index and AFG's Chapters column name it on ep 18 alone), so it is not a duplicate of anything the run shows elsewhere. NOT recap-clause material: the segment is not re-shown footage of anything this TV series had covered — the story's only earlier animation is a separate 2016 OVA bundled with the film's limited-edition BD/DVD, and ep 18 re-tells it with a new frame and new scenes (see the divergence annotation).

The adaptation of the omake is a RE-TELLING, not a page-faithful pass, and the faithfulness clause (T28) keeps the standing rather than changing it — recorded so the row is not read as a straight adaptation. (1) FRAMING: ja-WP says 原案としている ('used as the basis'); the anime re-stages the omake as Boruto's recollection while he nurses a feverish Himawari, a frame the omake does not have. (2) ADDED: Naruto arriving home drunk the night before after celebrating with his friends, and Iruka being the only one in the crowd to see through Konohamaru's transformation — neither is in the omake's or the OVA's summary (the drunk-arrival gag exists only as a still illustration over the OVA's end credits). (3) DROPPED: the OVA/omake's ceremony audience beats (Sarada and Chōchō, Sakura's pride). (4) PRIOR ANIMATION: the same story had already been animated once, as the OVA 『ナルトが火影になった日』 released 2016-07-06 on the limited-edition BD/DVD of Boruto: Naruto the Movie (ja-WP: 同エピソードは劇場版のDVD/BD特典映像として先にアニメ化されている; Narutopedia's OVA page: 'Some scenes appear in episode 18'). Whether individual cuts were re-used or re-drawn could not be established on a primary — no source states it either way — but the OVA is outside this TV series' coverage, so the T28 recap clause is not in play and the segment is weighed as first-time-in-series adaptation of the omake.

annotations.note: CONFIRMED AS STORED and enriched with the per-episode novel map the stored record lacked. THE WORK: the licensed light novel Naruto Shinden: Parent and Child Day, second installment of the 2018 Naruto Shinden series — a prose work, no manga chapters, hence no mapping (A1 / T26; the Sasuke Retsuden rows 282-286 and the Steam Ninja Scrolls rows 106-111 on this same series are the identical shape). weight per episode: SIGNIFICANT in all three — each episode IS its novel chapter end to end, not a fragment of one. Ep 93: the holiday's creation, Naruto's night of paperwork, Himawari's Kurama plush hunt with Kiba, Ino, Tenten, and the border-mission father Naruto reassigns to a village gate. Ep 94: the four sponsor restaurants, Karui walking out, Chōchō's eating-contest plan, the Dōtonbori challengers (novel characters — ja-WP lists クーイ / ダオーレ as 『ナルト新伝 親子の日』に登場), the Ankorodō owner's Earth Release, Chōza's vision, Butterfly Mode. Ep 95: Sasuke's return, the failed bonding, Kakashi's Icha Icha advice, Shino, the shuriken training and the Hokage confession. NO BORUTO MANGA PAGE IS IN ANY OF THE THREE — the ask's check comes back negative on the strongest instrument available: Narutopedia's semantic per-episode `Manga Chapter` property returns 71 Boruto rows and none of 93/94/95 is among them, and AFG prints the literal token 'NOVEL' in the cell where it prints chapter numbers.

annotations.chapters: Naruto Shinden: Parent and Child Day — the whole of chapter 2 「父と娘、幸せのカタチ」 and all four interludes (「ごはん!」「ゲマキ!」「おやこ!」「モンペ?」) are unadapted
annotations.note: The three episodes are a CONDENSED pass over the novel, and under the faithfulness clause the cuts keep the rows canon rather than changing the type. Narutopedia's 'Novel Adaptation Differences' page states it directly: 'The entirety of Chapter 2 and the Interludes were not adapted in the anime' — that is the Hinata / Hanabi / Hiashi story (the feigned illness, the trading-card mission in the hot-spring mists) and Shino's festival activities, of which only his possession of the Kurama doll survives into the anime, as the running gag in all three episodes. Ep 93 keeps one thread of the cut chapter as a single line (Hinata leaving to visit her own father). The other named change is a re-assignment, not an addition: in the novel Sarada runs into Sasuke and tells him about the holiday, in the anime it is Boruto (Novel Adaptation Differences, citing episode 95; TV Tokyo's ep-95 synopsis says the same: ボルトはサスケに新しい祝日“親子の日”の話をし). No anime-original PLOT of substance was added in exchange — which is why the row stays canon and AFL's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' has nothing to point at.

type_corrections.note: CONFIRMED AS STORED — mixed. Segment accounting, T28. SEGMENT 1 (the first half, a flashback): Kishimoto's manga omake 'The Day Naruto Became Hokage' — Naruto overslept on his inauguration morning, the unfinished Hokage cloak, the torn stuffed toy, Himawari's Byakugan awakening and the finger strike that closes Naruto's tenketsu, Konohamaru transformed into Naruto to open the ceremony, Boruto hiding in the closet. weight: SIGNIFICANT — because it is a self-contained story-carrying half of the episode (ja-WP: 前半部分), it is the reason the episode exists (it establishes why Naruto has been absent from home ever since), and it is adapted in no other episode. SEGMENT 2 (the present day, the frame): anime-original — Boruto nursing a feverish Himawari, his resentment of the Hokage's absence, Naruto arriving with his cloak inside out, the argument over what Himawari should eat, Ichiraku with Naruto, the Akimichi ramen-eating contest and the reveal that Hinata holds the record, Hinata's closing recollection. weight: SIGNIFICANT — it opens and closes the episode and carries the father-son beat. A licensed work's story and anime-original story, both story-carrying, in one episode = MIXED (T25/T27/T28). WHICH SOURCE LIED, AND HOW: AFL's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' lands on the right TYPE for the wrong reason — its canon component is not the Boruto manga (Narutopedia's per-episode Manga Chapter index skips this row while carrying 700-710 on the neighbouring 19-24), it is an unnumbered movie-book omake; AFG is the source that says what is actually there, printing 'OMAKE: The Day Naruto Became Hokage' in its Chapters cell. Narutopedia's `boruto = No` infobox flag agrees but is the field the traps list calls unreliable — it is the absent `Manga Chapter` property, not that flag, that carries the negative. NOTE THE OPEN FORK: this typing rests on the convention that a licensed side work confers standing (the same convention that types eps 93-95 / 106-111 / 282-286 canon here and Black Clover 55-56 canon); under the one-piece-50 line (a licensed novel is side_source on a FILLER row) segment 1 would carry no weight and ep 18 would be filler + side_source. Flagged for Sean rather than decided here — it is a block question, not a one-row question.

CONFIRMED AS STORED — canon (+ the stored side_source; AFL's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' is the label that lied on all three). Segment accounting, T28: each episode has exactly ONE story segment and it is the novel's. Ep 93 = the novel's prologue + chapter 1; ep 94 = chapter 3; ep 95 = chapter 4 — verified beat by beat against Narutopedia's chapter-by-chapter summary of 『ナルト新伝 親子の日』 and against TV Tokyo's per-episode synopses, with ja-WP's arc header (ノベライズ『NARUTO―ナルト― ナルト新伝 親子の日』を原作としてアニメ化) and Narutopedia's arc page ('This arc is an anime adaptation of the Naruto Shinden: Parent and Child Day novel') naming the work independently. weight: SIGNIFICANT for the novel segment in all three; there is NO anime-original segment of story-carrying size to set against it — what the anime did was CUT (novel ch 2 and all four interludes) and re-assign one scene (Boruto rather than Sarada tells Sasuke about the holiday), both of which the faithfulness clause keeps as canon-with-annotations (delivered as `abridged`). THE ASK'S MANGA CHECK, ANSWERED: no Boruto-manga page is in any of the three — Narutopedia's semantic `Manga Chapter` index returns 71 Boruto episodes and none of 93/94/95 is among them (neighbours 92 and 96 are absent too; the manga rows nearest are 66 and 148), and AFG prints 'NOVEL' in its Chapters cell for all three. THE SAME OPEN FORK AS EP 18: canon here follows this series' stored convention for licensed side works (106-111, 282-286) and Black Clover 55-56; under the one-piece-50 line these would be filler + side_source. That is a 14-row block decision for Sean, not a row-by-row flip, so the rows are delivered as stored.

structure.notes: PREMISE CORRECTION (the third on this page in two waves, and the reason R20/'a task premise is a claim' keeps earning its place): the ask says eps 93-95 'sit in the Mitsuki's Disappearance arc (anime-original)'. They do not. Mitsuki's Disappearance ENDS at ep 92 ('A New Ordinary'); 93-95 are their own arc — Narutopedia's 'Parent and Child Day Arc' page ('the tenth arc… covers episodes 93 to 95… preceded by the Mitsuki's Disappearance Arc and followed by Jūgo Arc') and ja-WP's own section header 親子の日編 spanning exactly 第93話-第95話. The correction does not change the answer (an anime-original arc and a novel-adaptation arc both carry zero Boruto chapters) but it changes what the row IS: a licensed adaptation, not padding. ROW IDENTITY: all four rows join cleanly on title + air date (R20) — AFL prints 18 'A Day in the Life of the Uzumaki Family' 2017-08-02, 93 'Family Day' 2019-02-10, 94 'A Heaping Helping! The Eating Contest!' 2019-02-17, 95 'Tactics for Getting Along With Your Daughter' 2019-02-24, all matching our rows; Narutopedia titles ep 93 'Parent and Child Day' (Japanese 親子の日) where VIZ's novel translation and our row read 'Family Day' — a title-variant, not a different row (the infobox's japanese airdate 2019-02-10 and episode=93 field settle it). AFG's row numbering also matches ours on all four (its ep 93 cell reads 'Parent and Child Day'). SOURCE LINEAGES USED, and their independence: (1) Narutopedia — episode pages, the omake chapter page, the OVA page, the Zai no Sho book page, the arc page, the novel's chapter-by-chapter summary, the 'Novel Adaptation Differences' page, and its SEMANTIC per-episode `Manga Chapter` index (askargs) which is the reverse instrument the ask wanted; (2) ja-WP's 各話リスト prose footnotes (ep-18 row Efn2 and the 親子の日編 header Efn2) — read as prose, no legend on this page; (3) the licensor: TV Tokyo's あにてれ back-numbers via the Wayback Machine (2017-08-02 and 2019-03-29 snapshots) — note that Bandai Channel's per-episode page (b-ch.com/titles/5583/018) prints TV Tokyo's text verbatim, so those two are ONE lineage, not two; (4) cross-check only: AFL and AFG (and AFG's chapter column is Narutopedia's infobox restated, so it is not independent of (1) either — it is quoted here only because its non-numeric tokens 'OMAKE: …' and 'NOVEL' are the clearest statement of what the rows adapt).
structure.coverage_set_checked: Boruto manga chapter space (the entry's instrument: 80 numbered chapters, 20 volumes). Checked the WHOLE run's manga coverage, not just the four rows: Narutopedia's semantic index of Boruto episodes carrying a `Manga Chapter` property returns exactly 71 rows — 1, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 39, 53-59, 61-66, 106, 148-151, 157, 181-189, 192-208, 210-220, 287-293 — of which 19-24 and 106 are qualified `Manga = Naruto` (the ch 700 / Gaiden 700+N chain space, lane I's business) and the rest `Manga = Boruto`. Eps 18, 93, 94 and 95 appear NOWHERE in that set, and neither do their neighbours 92 and 96-105. No numbered Boruto chapter is left unadapted by declining to anchor these four: the Boruto space's coverage line runs unbroken around them (ep 66 -> ch 10, ep 148 -> ch 11), and the omake and the novel are outside it by construction. No stored anchor is touched, no continue moves.

flags_for_sean: THE BLOCK FORK BEHIND BOTH VERDICTS (please rule; it is worth more than these four rows). Two catalog lines disagree about what a LICENSED SIDE WORK does to a row's standing: batch 18 says a second licensed work is `side_source` on a CANON row (Black Clover 55-56 adapt a novel), and this series is stored that way on 14 rows (93-95 Parent and Child Day, 106-111 Steam Ninja Scrolls, 282-286 Sasuke Retsuden, all canon + side_source); the one-piece-50 ruling (2026-09-04) says a licensed novel the anime adapts is `side_source` on a FILLER row unless an `adopted{basis}` ruling exists. Under the first line ep 18 is mixed (delivered) and 93-95 are canon (delivered); under the second, ep 18 is filler + side_source and 93-95 are filler + side_source, and the same flip would have to run across 106-111 and 282-286 — 15 rows on this series alone. I delivered the stored convention because a piecemeal flip would be worse than either answer. If you want the one-piece-50 line to govern, it is one atomic block repair, not a row-by-row pass.

SHOULD THE OMAKE JOIN THE I41 CHAIN? 'The Day Naruto Became Hokage' is a Kishimoto MANGA omake in the same continuity, printed in the Boruto movie book alongside a reprint of Naruto ch 700 — closer to the ruled chain (Naruto -> Naruto Gaiden -> Boruto) than to a foreign licensed work. I delivered it as `side_source` because the ruled chain names three works and this is not one of them, and because nothing mechanical turns on the choice (it is position-less either way, having no chapter number at all). If you would rather the chain map carried it as a fourth, unnumbered member, the home is the chain ruling that ep 24's verdict asked for (lib/rulings/source-chains.ts) and the annotation kind changes to `chain_source` with the same text.

AFL'S MIXED BUCKET ON THIS SERIES IS NOW EXHAUSTIVELY CHARACTERISED, and it is not a type signal at all. Across waves 3 and 22 the ten 'Mixed Canon/Filler' rows have turned out to be: a 2-minute cold open (1), an episode with no source of any kind (127), a closing status report (157), a genuine mixed row whose source is another work in the chain (24), four rows carrying real Boruto chapters (59, 192, 210-211), an unnumbered movie-book omake (18), and a straight three-episode adaptation of a licensed novel with no original plot at all (93-95). The bucket means 'something outside the current manga thread is present', in either direction and at any size. Recommend the AFL type lane be treated as non-evidential for this series (it is already one lineage with AFG, whose class column copies it) — the instruments that actually work here are Narutopedia's semantic `Manga Chapter` property and ja-WP's per-row prose footnotes.

PIPELINE CHECK (not a repair, no row is wrong today): AFG's Chapters column on this page carries NON-NUMERIC tokens ('OMAKE: The Day Naruto Became Hokage' on ep 18, 'NOVEL' on 93-95) and, worse for a parser, NARUTO-SPACE numbers on eps 19-24 and 106 ('701, 702' … '700') that would be sixty-plus chapters past the Boruto manga's 80 if they were ever ingested as Boruto chapters. Nothing has landed (our anchors on this series start at ep 53 -> ch 1), so whatever gate refuses them is working; worth an explicit assertion in the AFG writer's tests so it stays that way, since the tokens sit in the same column the writer reads.
